title: Thermal Aluminum Casing 热力膨胀:铝机壳
description: A texture pack that brings Thermal Series machines and pipes visually closer to the Create mod.
body:
Description
Thermal: Aluminum Casing is a texture pack that gives Thermal Series machines and pipes a visual refresh inspired by the Create mod.

**Includes:**

 ✅ Selected machines

 ✅ All pipes

 ✅ All Dynamos

 

热力膨胀：铝机壳 是一款让热力系列的机器和管线在视觉上更贴近机械动力模组的材质包。

 **包含内容：**

 ✅ 部分机器

 ✅ 所有管道

 ✅ 所有发电机
